description_en: Queries the execution information of a workflow task
description_zh: 查询工作流执行任务信息
name: GetWorkflowTask

parameters.help_en: The task ID used to query the refresh status
parameters.name: task_id

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when transcoding fails

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when transcoding fails

FinishTimeUtc.description_en: The time when the task was completed. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
FinishTimeUtc.description_zh: 任务完成时间。格式为: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

GmtCreateUtc.description_en: The time when the task was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format

NodeResults.description_en: The node results of the workflow task. The value is in JSON format and varies based on the workflow configuration
NodeResults.description_zh: 工作流任务的节点结果。Json格式，内容根据工作流配置有变化

Status.description_en:
The result of this review. This indicates the current manual review result. Valid values:
running: Running.
stopped: Stopped.
failed: Failed.
partial-succeeded: Partially succeeded.
succeeded: Succeeded
Status.description_zh:
本次审核结果。表示当前人工审核的结果，取值范围：
running：运行中。
stopped：已停止。
failed：已失败。
partial-succeeded：部分成功。
succeeded：已完成

TaskId.description_en: The task ID used to query the refresh status

WorkflowId.description_en: The workflow ID. You can log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose Configuration Management > Media Processing > Workflow Management to view the ID
WorkflowId.description_zh: 工作流ID。可登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择配置管理 > 媒体处理配置 > 工作流管理查看ID
